create_bernoulli_distribution: create a Bernoulli distribution with probs or logits parameter for binary sampling
sample_from_bernoulli: sample binary values (0 or 1) from a Bernoulli distribution with given probability
compute_bernoulli_log_prob: compute log probability of a value under a Bernoulli distribution
compute_bernoulli_entropy: compute entropy of a Bernoulli distribution from its logits
enumerate_bernoulli_support: enumerate all possible values (0 and 1) supported by a Bernoulli distribution
